title: Without classes
text: One stylesheet, classless.css, for a page of plain HTML with no classes: how to take it, link it, and grow into the components.

title: Standards
text: Linted, formatted, evaluated, tested, followed, and documented.

title: Writing style
text: Plain text, no emoji, and American English with the Oxford comma.

title: Components
text: Oinam UI: components in plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, with no framework.

title: Install
text: Link the stylesheet and scripts, copy the files, or hand the guide to an agent.

title: Tokens
text: Colors, type, space, and shape. Two colors do all the work: ink and cloud.

title: Wrap
text: Centers the page content and keeps it off the edges.

title: Stack
text: A column. Children sit one under the other, a gap apart.

title: Row
text: A row that wraps. Children sit side by side, a gap apart.

title: Grid
text: Equal columns, as many as fit, with no breakpoints.

title: Text
text: A small label above a heading, and an opening paragraph a size up.

title: Prose
text: A run of writing. Plain headings, paragraphs, and lists get their rhythm.

title: Card
text: Groups related things on a raised surface.

title: Badge
text: A small label: a status, a kind, a count, a "new".

title: Alert
text: Sets a message apart: a note, a warning, or danger.

title: Table
text: Frames a plain table and lets a wide one scroll sideways.

title: Facts
text: A list of names and their values, each pair on a line, ruled apart.

title: Avatar
text: A small round picture of someone, or their initials.

title: Item
text: One row in a list: something to know it by, a title and a line, and an action.

title: Empty
text: Stands where content will be once there is some.

title: Skeleton
text: Holds the place of something that is still loading.

title: Spinner
text: Says that something is under way.

title: Progress
text: How far along something is, on a <progress>.

title: Ratio
text: Keeps a picture, a video, or a frame to a fixed shape.

title: Scroll
text: A frame for something too long to show at once.

title: Button
text: A button, on a <button> or an <a>.

title: Button group
text: Joins buttons that belong together into one piece.

title: Field
text: A label, its control, and a line of help, kept together.

title: Input group
text: Puts a unit, a prefix, or a button inside the frame of a field.

title: Choice and switch
text: A checkbox, a radio button, or a switch, with its label.

title: Slider
text: A value chosen by sliding, on an <input type="range">.

title: Toggle
text: A button that stays pressed, alone or in a group.

title: Breadcrumb
text: Where this page sits, from the top down.

title: Pagination
text: Links to the pages of a long list.

title: Accordion
text: A set of <details> that open and close.

title: Tabs
text: Turns a run of sections into tabs.

title: Dialog
text: A modal or a drawer, on a <dialog>, opened and closed without script.

title: Popover
text: A small panel that opens under the button that names it.

title: Menu
text: A button and the short list of actions it opens.

title: Tooltip
text: A few words about a control, on hover or focus.

title: Copy
text: Adds a copy button to a block of code.

title: Theme
text: A light and dark toggle that remembers the choice.

title: Toast
text: Brief messages that appear in a corner and go away again.

title: Example
text: Shows markup at work and prints its source beside it.

title: Classless
text: One stylesheet for a page of plain HTML with no classes: the same tokens and Base, with buttons, fields, tables, and details dressed as their components look.

title: Patterns
text: Whole pages built from the components, to follow when composing one.

title: Pattern: a form
text: One narrow column, fields grouped under names, help under each field, and one button that says what it does.

title: Pattern: a table view
text: Many like things as a table, with one main action, a filter, a status, and each row's actions in a menu.

title: Pattern: settings
text: Rows with a name on one side and a control on the other, and a dangerous action that asks first.

title: Pattern: a list, empty and full
text: The same list with boats expected, with none, and while it loads.

title: Pattern: an article
text: Writing in one column: a date, a title, a lede, plain prose, a table, and one thing not to miss.

title: Pattern: a dashboard
text: A sentence that says what matters now, what needs a decision, and the figures beside it. No charts.

title: Components guide
text: The whole system as one page of plain text, for AI agents.

title: Adopting into an existing site
text: Bringing the system into a site that already has its own styles, build, and pages, one part at a time.

title: Why
text: What each rule of the system protects, what it costs, and when it may be bent.

title: Icons
text: Phosphor's icons in four weights: which goes where, how to inline one, and drawing one that is missing.

title: Tokens as data
text: The tokens in the Design Tokens format, for tools that cannot read CSS.

title: Play
text: Change the fonts, corners, and colors, watch every component follow, and take the variation away.

title: Garden
text: One page and many designs of it. Each is a few lines of tokens. Add yours.

title: Colors
text: Pairs of colors, side by side in light and dark, each three tokens with every shade mixed from them.
